subject: Timeseries plot: How to add mixed legend for both points and lines in the same plot?

messages.subject: Timeseries plot: How to add mixed legend for both points and lines in the same plot?
parts:

### Melt
library(reshape2)
Obs_melt <- melt(Obs_df, id.vars = c("Date"))
Sim_melt <- melt(Sim_df, id.vars = c("Date"))

### Plot
library(ggplot2)
# Plot simulated series first
Sim_plot <- ggplot(data = Sim_melt, aes(x = Date, y = value)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = variable, color="Simulated")) +
  scale_color_manual("Legend", values=c("#999999")) +

messages.author: 942ffec526d6a312
messages.subject: Re: Timeseries plot: How to add mixed legend for both points and lines in the same plot?
parts:
Tung,

There is probably a better way of doing this but how about bringing
the simulated and observed data together, then using scale_size_manual
and scale_linetype_manual to remove the points and lines you do not
want to show:

# combine observed and simulated data
all <- rbind(Obs_melt,Sim_melt)

# factor to differentiate observed and simulated (no differentiation
between individual simulations)
all$vfac <-
factor(ifelse(all$variable=="Obs","Observed","Simulated"),levels=c("Simulated","Observed"))

Sim_plot <- ggplot(data = all, aes(x = Date, y = value)) +
geom_line(aes(group = variable,colour=vfac,linetype=vfac))+
geom_point(aes(group=variable,size=vfac,colour=vfac))+
scale_colour_manual(name="Legend",values=c("#999999","#0000FF"))+
scale_size_manual(name="Legend",values=c(0,2))+ # zero size for
simulated points
scale_linetype_manual(name="Legend",values=c(1,0)) # no linetype for
observed data

Ron.

messages.subject: Re: Timeseries plot: How to add mixed legend for both points and lines in the same plot?
parts:
Hi Ron,

Thanks a lot for helping! It works nicely now. I also expand your code a little bit to automatically plot different color for different simulations

# Ref: https://github.com/jennybc/STAT545A_2013/blob/master/block14_colors.rmd
library(RColorBrewer)
# get number of variables
n_q <- length(levels(all$variable))
# get color based on number of variables
display.brewer.pal(n = n_q, name = 'Dark2')
jBrewColors <- brewer.pal(n = n_q, name = "Dark2")
# number of simulation (minus observation)
n_sim <- n_q - 1
# got values for point & lines later
zero_point <- rep(0, n_sim)
one_point <- rep(1, n_sim)

all$vfac2 <- factor(all$variable)
Sim_plot <- ggplot(data = all, aes(x = Date, y = value)) +

geom_line(aes(group = variable, colour = vfac2, linetype = vfac2))+
  geom_point(aes(group = variable, size = vfac2, colour = vfac2))+   
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Legend", values = jBrewColors)+
  scale_size_manual(name = "Legend", values = c(2, zero_point))+ # zero size for simulated points
  scale_linetype_manual(name="Legend",values = c(0, one_point)) # no linetype for observed data
Sim_plot

Cheers,

Tung
